## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A 4-juan classical Chinese siege-defence manual by Chén Guī, based on his successful defence of Déān during the Jīngkāng / Jiànyán Sòng-Jīn wars. The work is one of the principal Sòng-period military-technical treatises. Composition: bracketed by Chén's mature military career, with the work probably composed in the 1130s during his Déān tenure. The frontmatter brackets to ca. 1130–1141.

**Abstract**

The *Shǒu chéng lù* is the principal Sòng-period siege-defence treatise. The work is heavily cited in modern military-historical scholarship on Sòng-Jīn warfare.

The bibliographic record: *Sòng shǐ yìwén zhì*; SKQS *Zǐbù — Bīngjiā lèi*.
